title: Image Statistics
text: Calculate mean, variance, and standard deviation, 2 inputs, 4 outputs; {Enable mean output} sets the calculate the mean of each input frame, {Enable variance output} sets the calculate the variance of each input frame and {Enable std. deviation} sets the calculate the standard deviation of each input. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

ports.name: mean
ports.summary: Mean of most recent input frame completed scalar

ports.name: var
ports.summary: Variance of most recent input frame completed scalar

ports.name: stdDev
ports.summary: Standard deviation of most recent input frame completed scalar

params.name: Enable mean output
params.values: Calculate the mean of each input frame on (default) | off

params.name: Enable variance output
params.values: Calculate the variance of each input frame on (default) | off

params.name: Enable std. deviation
params.values: Calculate the standard deviation of each input frame on (default) | off
